youtube_short.title: Minimum Payments Cost You $19,000 Extra
title_alternatives: Your Credit Card Minimum Is a $19K Trap
Why Minimum Payments Take 22 Years to Clear
youtube_short.description: If you've ever paid just the minimum on a $5,000 credit card balance, you're looking at 22 years of payments and $19,000 in interest — by design. Banks calculate the minimum to maximize how much you pay them, not to help you escape debt. Adding just $50 extra a month cuts that down to 4 years and saves $15,000. #creditcarddebt #personalfinance #moneytips #debtfree Subscribe for more money traps banks hope you never find out about.
